package.description: Connect/disconnect Bluetooth headphones (AirPods, etc.) with one click from the Windows tray.

en-US.description: Connect/disconnect Bluetooth headphones (AirPods, etc.) with one click from the Windows tray.
en-US.longDescription:
easy-handoff is a small system tray app that connects or disconnects a paired Bluetooth audio device
(AirPods, Sony, Bose, ...) with a single left click, without opening the Bluetooth settings.
Handy when you switch your earbuds between a phone and a Windows PC.
en-US.name: easy-handoff

ja-JP.description: AirPods などの Bluetooth イヤホンを、タスクトレイからワンクリックで接続/切断します。
ja-JP.longDescription:
easy-handoff は、ペアリング済みの Bluetooth オーディオ機器（AirPods、Sony、Bose など）を
Bluetooth 設定を開かずに、タスクトレイのアイコンを左クリックするだけで接続/切断できる常駐アプリです。
スマホと Windows PC でイヤホンを行き来させるときに便利です。
ja-JP.name: easy-handoff
